profile.name: 规则任务组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于实验相关的数据处理与集群任务编排。它负责在规则触发前准备元数据和提交参数、提交规则任务、跟踪任务进度、等待任务完成，并在结束后执行清理。结合派生类可用于配方处理、本地化分析以及实时数据完成后的后处理流程，也可配合监视器在 Jupyter 笔记本中显示规则进度。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for experiment-related data processing and cluster task orchestration. It prepares metadata and submission arguments before a rule is triggered, posts rule tasks, tracks progress, waits for completion, and performs cleanup afterward. Via derived classes it can support recipe processing, localization analysis, and end-of-data post-processing, and it can be used with watchers to display rule progress in Jupyter notebooks.

registry.description: Single object / thread to watch multiple rules
